qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Possesses extensive European spectrum and fixed cable network assets, but operates in structurally commoditized, capital-intensive markets. Chronic value destruction is evidenced by 5-year GAAP ROIC languishing between 0.1% and 3.8% (well below 12% threshold) and inability to price above inflation.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3 (Moat & Pricing Power). Capital-intensive telecom network operator across Europe and Africa. Suffers from chronic sub-hurdle capital efficiency (5-year GAAP ROIC <4% vs 12% hurdle), heavy recurring 5G/cable capex, and lack of pricing power amid cutthroat market competition and regulatory price scrutiny.
qualitative.evidence: Vodafone's multi-year ROIC has persistently trailed WACC, averaging <4% for over a decade. Elevated debt (>€30B) prompted distressed divestments of Italian and Spanish units. In Germany (largest market), the abolition of the housing association bulk-billing privilege (Nebenkostenprivileg) in 2024 sparked severe TV subscriber losses. Structural failure of Gate 3b.
